title: Digital marketing manager vs affiliate ad-ops keyword trap
description: A 6-year non-tech digital marketing manager (SEO, Google Ads, GA4, email automation) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong growth-marketing match with Amazon Ads/Klaviyo gaps, one lifecycle-marketing match, one affiliate ad-ops data-entry trap stuffed with SEO/Ads keywords, one marginal marketing-analyst role, and four cross-family distractors.
rationale: The resume is a six-year non-tech digital-marketing manager with an SEO / Google Ads / GA4 / HubSpot email-automation core, exercising the platform outside engineering vocabularies. j3 is the keyword trap: an affiliate-network data-entry role whose posting is saturated with the resume's exact keywords (SEO, Google Ads, GA4, SEMrush, UTM) yet the actual work is rote checklist data entry with strategy explicitly excluded — TF-IDF over-ranks it while the guideline grades keyword-only overlap 0. Gap target j1 is a same-family growth role with heavy overlap on SEO, Google Ads, GA4, email automation, and A/B testing (justifying grade 3), while Amazon Ads (required, high), Klaviyo (preferred but only partially covered by the resume's HubSpot automation work, medium), and TikTok Ads and Google BigQuery (preferred, low) are the annotated gaps. j2 lifecycle/retention marketing is a close neighbor with most requirements covered, hence grade 2. j4 marketing data analyst probes the graded boundary: real GA4/analytics overlap but a SQL/BI core the resume lacks, hence grade 1.

resume.summary: Digital marketing manager with 6 years of experience growing DTC and B2B brands across organic and paid channels. Owns the full funnel: SEO and content, Google and Meta advertising, lifecycle email automation in HubSpot, and GA4-based measurement and experimentation.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Growth Marketing Manager — Loam & Leaf (Remote, US)

Loam & Leaf sells premium home-gardening kits to 300K customers and is scaling past $40M in revenue. We are hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own acquisition and retention end to end.

What you will do:
- Own paid and organic acquisition across Google Ads, our SEO program, and marketplace channels
- Run the lifecycle email program from segmentation to send
- Own the A/B testing roadmap across landing pages, ads, and email
- Report channel performance to leadership through GA4 dashboards

Requirements: SEO, Google Ads, GA4, email automation, Amazon Ads. 5+ years in growth or digital marketing for ecommerce with hands-on ownership of a six-figure monthly paid budget. Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

Nice to have: Klaviyo, TikTok Ads, Google BigQuery.

Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Manager — Petalport (Hybrid, Atlanta GA)

Petalport delivers subscription flower boxes, and retention is the whole business. We are hiring a Lifecycle Manager to make every message earn its place.

You will own lifecycle email and SMS programs from strategy to send, build segmentation and triggered flows for onboarding, upsell, and win-back, measure program impact in GA4, and run A/B tests on subject lines, offers, and send timing.

Requirements: email automation, customer segmentation, GA4, A/B testing. 4+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing. Bonus: HubSpot or a similar automation platform, SMS marketing.

jobs.raw_text:
Ad Operations Data Entry Associate — ClickHarvest Network (Onsite, Tampa FL)

ClickHarvest operates 400+ affiliate comparison microsites, and volume is our whole game. We need a detail-obsessed associate to keep the campaigns fed.

You will bulk-upload keyword lists into Google Ads accounts, paste UTM parameters onto thousands of affiliate links, copy GA4 traffic numbers into tracking spreadsheets, refresh SEO title tags from a template across microsites, and reorder SEMrush keyword exports for the campaign leads.

Requirements: fast, accurate data entry; spreadsheet basics; ability to follow SEO and Google Ads checklists exactly as written. No strategy work — our playbooks are fixed. 1+ years in data entry or ad operations support.

Marketing Data Analyst — Corvid Insights (Remote, US)

Requirements: SQL, Tableau, GA4, marketing data modeling. 3+ years in analytics. Bonus: Python, dbt.

Ferrostack builds inventory APIs for industrial suppliers. We are hiring a Backend Engineer to extend our order-orchestration services.

Requirements: Python or Go, PostgreSQL, REST API design, containerized deployments with Docker. 4+ years building production backend services. Bonus: Kafka, AWS.

Highbeam Capital is a 30-person growth-equity firm, and our two managing partners need an EA who runs their world.

Warehouse Operations Supervisor — Loam & Leaf (Onsite, Macon GA)

Loam & Leaf ships 6,000 gardening kits a week from our Macon fulfillment center, and peak season doubles that. We need a Supervisor to run the floor.

You will supervise a 25-person pick-pack team across two shifts, own inbound receiving and cycle-count accuracy, and drive safety compliance and daily throughput targets.

Requirements: warehouse team supervision, WMS experience, inventory-control processes, OSHA-aware safety practices. 3+ years supervising fulfillment or distribution teams.
